title: Project Cinnabar — Escrow agreement (execution version, excerpt)
text:
ESCROW AGREEMENT — PROJECT CINNABAR
VAERENBERGH PARTICIPATIES NV / THISTLEWOOD ENERGY INVESTMENTS LIMITED / DESCHEEMAEKER & VRANCKX NOTARISSEN BV
Execution version — excerpt
Cnockaert Wynants Advocaten BV — Our ref.: CW-26-1447/ESC (Cnockaert / Wynants)

THIS ESCROW AGREEMENT is dated 3 September 2026 and made between:

(1) VAERENBERGH PARTICIPATIES NV, a naamloze vennootschap incorporated in Belgium, with registered office at Hoogkamerstraat 212, 9100 Sint-Niklaas, registered with the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises under number 0731.256.472 (the "Seller");

(2) THISTLEWOOD ENERGY INVESTMENTS LIMITED, a private company limited by shares incorporated in England and Wales, registered at Companies House under number 11493827, with registered office at 27 Fetter Passage, London EC4A 1NL (the "Buyer" or "Thistlewood"); and

(3) DESCHEEMAEKER & VRANCKX NOTARISSEN BV, a besloten vennootschap with office at Zwartzustersvest 141, 2800 Mechelen, enterprise number 0776.342.963, acting through Mr. Filip Descheemaeker, notary (the "Escrow Agent"),

together the "Parties".

WHEREAS

(A) By a share purchase agreement dated 19 June 2026 (the "SPA"), the Seller has agreed to sell to the Buyer all shares in Kempische Windkracht NV, enterprise number 0648.913.271, with registered office at Oevelse Dreef 18, 2260 Westerlo ("KWK" or the "Company"), for EUR 58,400,000. The Parties refer to the transaction as Project Cinnabar.

(B) Completion is conditional on the European Commission declaring the concentration compatible with the internal market under Article 6(1)(b) of Regulation (EC) No 139/2004 (the "Clearance Condition"). Thistlewood notified the concentration on 21 August 2026 (Case M.12917); a decision is expected by 23 October 2026.

(C) Under Clause 6.4 of the SPA, EUR 7,250,000 of the purchase price (the "Escrow Amount") is retained at Completion as security for Warranty Claims and Tax Claims (together "Claims").

IT IS AGREED

1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 Terms defined in the SPA have the same meaning here. In addition:

"Escrow Account" means the third-party account (derdenrekening) opened by the Escrow Agent with ING, IBAN BE13 3631 8027 4439, BIC BBRUBEBB, sub-heading "Cinnabar";

"Joint Instruction" means a written instruction signed for the Seller by Mr. Wouter Dierckxsens and for the Buyer by Ms. Harriet Ollerenshaw, or by a replacement Authorised Signatory notified under Clause 8.3.

2. APPOINTMENT AND ESCROW

2.1 The Seller and the Buyer appoint the Escrow Agent as conventional sequestrator (séquestre conventionnel) of the Escrow Amount within the meaning of Articles 1956 to 1958 of the old Belgian Civil Code, and the Escrow Agent accepts.

2.2 On the Completion Date the Buyer shall transfer the Escrow Amount to the Escrow Account. The Escrow Amount is held separately from the Escrow Agent's assets; interest credited by ING follows the principal.

2.3 If the Clearance Condition is not satisfied by 26 February 2027 (the "Long Stop Date") and the SPA terminates, this Agreement terminates automatically.

3. RELEASE

3.1 On 12 March 2027 (the "First Release Date") the Escrow Agent shall release to the Seller EUR 2,500,000, less Claims then notified and unresolved.

3.2 On 30 September 2027 (the "Second Release Date") the Escrow Agent shall release to the Seller the balance of the Escrow Account, less outstanding Claims, which remain in escrow until resolved under Clause 6.

3.3 The Escrow Agent shall otherwise release funds only on a Joint Instruction, a determination under Clause 6.1 or an enforceable judgment of the court referred to in Clause 10.1.

6. DISPUTES ON CLAIMS

6.1 If a Claim remains disputed after thirty Business Days, either the Seller or the Buyer may refer its quantum to an independent bedrijfsrevisor appointed by agreement or, failing that, by the Chairman of the Instituut van de Bedrijfsrevisoren (the "Expert"), whose determination is final save for manifest error.

8. FEES AND NOTICES

8.1 The Escrow Agent's fee is EUR 5,900 (excluding VAT), borne equally by the Seller and the Buyer.

8.2 Notices shall be sent by email and courier to:

(a) the Seller: Vaerenbergh Participaties NV, Hoogkamerstraat 212, 9100 Sint-Niklaas, attention Mr. Wouter Dierckxsens, Managing Director (w.dierckxsens@vaerenbergh.example.be; +32 3 292 61 47), with a copy to Ms. Saskia Cnockaert and Mr. Joachim Wynants, Cnockaert Wynants Advocaten BV, Wetenschapsstraat 33, 1040 Brussels (s.cnockaert@cnockaert-wynants.example.be; +32 2 640 81 93);

(b) the Buyer: Thistlewood Energy Investments Limited, 27 Fetter Passage, London EC4A 1NL, attention Ms. Harriet Ollerenshaw, Director and General Counsel (h.ollerenshaw@thistlewood.example.co.uk; +44 20 7183 9026);

(c) the Escrow Agent: Descheemaeker & Vranckx, Zwartzustersvest 141, 2800 Mechelen, attention Mr. Descheemaeker (escrow@descheemaeker-vranckx.example.be; +32 15 63 08 72). Joint Instructions may also be uploaded at portaal.descheemaeker-vranckx.example.be.

8.3 Until the Escrow Agent receives a notice of replacement countersigned by the outgoing signatory, only Mr. Dierckxsens and Ms. Ollerenshaw may sign Joint Instructions.

9. GENERAL

9.1 The Seller confirms that its signatories represent it under Article 7:93 of the Belgian Companies and Associations Code and that the transfer of the shares in KWK will be recorded in the Company's share register at Completion.

10. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION

10.1 This Agreement is governed by Belgian law, although the SPA is governed by English law and subject to the Commercial Court in London. The Dutch-speaking Enterprise Court of Brussels has exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute under this Agreement.

SIGNED in three originals on 3 September 2026.

For the Seller, Vaerenbergh Participaties NV: Mr. Wouter Dierckxsens, Managing Director; Ms. Nele Pauwelyn, Director

For the Buyer, Thistlewood Energy Investments Limited: Ms. Harriet Ollerenshaw, Director and General Counsel; Mr. Dominic Featherby, Director

For the Escrow Agent, Descheemaeker & Vranckx Notarissen BV: Mr. Filip Descheemaeker, notary
notes: Excerpt of a Belgian-law escrow agreement holding the warranty retention under an English-law SPA: a Belgian seller, an English buyer and a Belgian notarial partnership as escrow agent, with the escrow account at a bank named only by acronym. SHOULD redact: the three parties in every form (title-line capitals, parties clause, notice block and signature page, the short form Thistlewood, the bare firm name Descheemaeker & Vranckx), the target Kempische Windkracht NV and its defined acronym KWK, the drafting firm Cnockaert Wynants Advocaten BV and its file reference CW-26-1447/ESC, the deal codename in all three forms (PROJECT CINNABAR, Project Cinnabar, bare Cinnabar as the account sub-heading), the Commission case number M.12917, all five street addresses and their postcode+city pairs, the three Belgian enterprise numbers and the English company number (typed IBAN for want of a registry-number type), the escrow IBAN and BIC, the bank ING (a party's banker here, not a regulator), the notary and the four signatories with and without honorifics, the two lawyers named in full in the notice block and by bare surname in the header line, the four example.* emails, the four phone numbers and the bare upload-platform domain. SHOULD NOT redact: European Commission, Regulation (EC) No 139/2004 and Article 6(1)(b), Crossroads Bank for Enterprises, Companies House, the (old) Belgian Civil Code and Articles 1956 to 1958, the Belgian Companies and Associations Code and Article 7:93, the Instituut van de Bedrijfsrevisoren, the Enterprise Court of Brussels, the Commercial Court in London, the countries and legal-form descriptors (Belgium, England and Wales, naamloze vennootschap, besloten vennootschap, notary, bedrijfsrevisor), the role words (the Seller, the Buyer, the Escrow Agent, the Parties, the Company, the Expert, the Authorised Signatory) and the defined commercial terms (Escrow Account as a defined term, Escrow Amount, Clearance Condition, Long Stop Date, First and Second Release Date, Joint Instruction, Claims), amounts and dates.
